works.title: 通知堆栈 · 悬停轮换与关闭
works.author: @raunofreiberg

acceptedSamples.description: Initial compact deck above persistent avatar, rauno account, more and bell controls. White rounded two-column container; left sidebar divider and empty right content. First full card is 50% off GPT-5.6 Sol with body and Learn More CTA; three narrow rear outlines are visible.
Cursor has entered the notification area; rear card outline rises slightly. First full notification remains unchanged. This stable decoded frame replaces the rejected seeking/old-frame capture.
Hover reveals the rear title Explore your project above the still-complete offer card; cursor becomes a hand over this exposed header. Container and account footer remain fixed.
Exposed Explore your project header remains hovered and readable; front card continues to show the first offer. Rear deck elevation is stable.
Following a click on the exposed header, Explore your project becomes the full front card with deployment/performance body and Explore Project CTA. Observability Plus is now the exposed next header.
Ship 26 is the full front card with registration/seats text and Register CTA. The first offer title has cycled to the exposed next header; cursor remains over the same header area.
The first offer is front again after the continuous cycle; Explore your project is the rear exposed header. Cursor begins leaving the header toward the front card.
Rear titles retract into compact thin outlines as the pointer leaves the exposed header. Full offer, CTA and footer remain visible.
Pointer is over the front close control; a pale circular hover fill is visible. Rear outlines are no longer visible, leaving the single full card before dismissal.
After close, the notification region is empty. The two-column container, sidebar divider and avatar/account/more/bell footer remain in place.
Near the actual source end the notification region stays empty; pointer has moved away. No CTA, bell or more-menu business result is displayed.
Supplementary middle sample: Observability Plus is front, with traces/retention body and Start Trial CTA; Ship 26 is the exposed next header. Confirms the third item omitted by coarser samples.
Supplementary sample immediately before cycle: first offer still front, Explore your project exposed, hand cursor over that header. Distinguishes rear-header selection from pressing the close button.
Supplementary close-hover sample: pale close-control circle and hand cursor; rear cards are visually hidden but first card remains fully present. Underlying data deletion cannot be inferred.
Close-hover state still present with only the first full notification. Confirms this is not a four-item sequential deletion animation.
Supplementary post-close sample: all visible notification cards have exited and the persistent footer remains. Confirms the popup area is dismissed as one visible unit.

mechanisms: Persistent two-column shell and account/footer controls
Compact four-card notification deck with scaled rear silhouettes
Selection of the exposed next header rotates the same deck through four full messages and back to the first
Leaving the exposed header retracts rear layers
Close-hover feedback hides rear layers; clicking close removes the visible notification surface while preserving the workspace
differences: Independent CSS/SVG geometry, original avatar and account identity replace source pixels; no source footage or screenshot is used by the module.
1920×1080 landscape container and 26-second timeline increase text size/read holds; interpolation, cursor movement and click ring are original animation details.

First card uses editable illustrative Workspace update copy in place of a dated commercial discount. Other bodies/CTAs are independently rewritten illustrative copy; source four-item order is retained.
CTA, bell and more controls remain visible as in source, without unobserved execution, navigation, purchasing or backend outcomes.
The visible notification area is dismissed as a surface. This does not claim that all underlying source messages were deleted, marked read or persisted.
unknowns: Source backend/product implementation and storage of dismissed notifications
Destination or result of source CTA buttons, bell and more menu
Hidden notifications or behavior after the source ends
Exact internal card layout/z-order algorithm; geometry reconstructed from observed rendered states
works.sourceObservationMethod: Exact source card modal and original href read; original remote video actually paused/viewed at accepted decoded samples. No remote pixels distributed. Not a full original source-code replica or real service execution.
